events.text: She sailed as MS Peter Wessel for Larvik Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Between 1984 and 2008 she sailed as MS Peter Wessel for Larvik Line

events.text: She sailed as MS Peter Wessel for Larvik Line until 1996.
events.subject: self
events.quote: for Larvik Line ( until 1996 )

events.text: She sailed as MS Peter Wessel for Color Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Between 1984 and 2008 she sailed as MS Peter Wessel

events.text: MS Visby was delivered.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The first ship , MS Visby , was delivered on 10 October 1980 .

events.text: The second ship, planned to be called MS Gotland, was delivered to Rederi Ab Gotland.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was delivered on 24 June 1981 to Rederi Ab Gotland .

events.text: The ship was chartered to Vaasanlaivat / Vasabåtarna, Finland and officially named MS Wasa Star.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on one day following her delivery the ship was chartered to Vaasanlaivat / Vasabåtarna , Finland and officially named MS Wasa Star .

events.text: The Wasa Star started traffic on the route connecting Vaasa to Sundsvall.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 July 1981 the brand new Wasa Star started traffic on the route connecting Vaasa in Finland to Sundsvall in Sweden

events.text: The ship was moved to the Vaasa – Umeå route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In February 1982 the ship was moved to the Vaasa – Umeå route

events.text: The ship was grounded near Holmsund.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 14 February 1981 the ship was grounded near Holmsund

events.text: The Wasa Star continued from Helsinki to Kiel, Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 16 February 1981 the Wasa Star continued from Helsinki to Kiel , Germany

events.text: The Wasa Star returned to the Vaasa – Sundsvall route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 April 1982 the Wasa Star returned to the Vaasa – Sundsvall route

events.text: She was taken out of traffic and laid up in Sundsvall.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 31 August 1982 she was taken out of traffic and laid up in Sundsvall

events.text: Vaasanlaivat sub-chartered her to Karageorgios Line, Greece.
events.subject: self
events.quote: until May 1983 , when Vaasanlaivat sub-chartered her to Karageorgios Line , Greece

events.text: She started trafficking on a route connecting Patras, Greece to Ancona, Italy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In June she started trafficking on a route connecting Patras , Greece to Ancona , Italy

events.text: The Wasa Star was sold to the Norwegian operator Larvik Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Wasa Star was sold to the Norwegian operator Larvik Line on 29 August 1983

events.text: She left Landskrona.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She left Landskrona on 13 January 1984

events.text: She was renamed MS Peter Wessel and started operating on the Larvik–Frederikshavn route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March of the same year she was renamed MS Peter Wessel

events.text: The Peter Wessel collided with MS Sydfjord.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Peter Wessel collided with MS Sydfjord on 27 June 1986

events.text: Peter Wessel was extended at Blohm + Voss, Hamburg, Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Peter Wessel was extended by meters at Blohm + Voss , Hamburg , Germany in 1988

events.text: Color Line chartered the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In October 1996 Color Line chartered the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line

events.text: Parts of the cardeck were built in with cabins.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1999 parts of the cardeck were built in with cabins

events.text: The ship was rebuilt again at Remontowa, Poland.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In spring 2003 the ship was rebuilt again , this time at Remontowa , Poland

events.text: Color Line bought the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2004 Color Line bought the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line

events.text: The ship was transferred to the Larvik—Hirtshals route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In April 2006 the ship was transferred to the Larvik—Hirtshals route .

events.text: A fire broke out in one of the ship's electric switchboards.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 22 March 2007 a fire broke out in one of the ships electric switchboards

events.text: The ship returned to service.
events.subject: self
events.quote: returning to service on 26 April 2007 .

events.text: Color Line reported that the Peter Wessel had been sold to Mediterranean Shipping Company.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 19 October 2007 Color Line reported that the Peter Wessel has been sold to Mediterranean Shipping Company

events.text: The Peter Wessel was delivered to her new owners.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Peter Wessel was delivered to her new owners on 16 April 2008

events.text: The ship was subsequently renamed MS SNAV Toscana.
events.subject: self
events.quote: subsequently renamed MS SNAV Toscana

events.text: The SNAV Toscana left Norway for the Mediterranean.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 19 April 2008 the SNAV Toscana left Norway for the Mediterranean .

events.text: She entered service on SNAV's Civitavecchia—Palermo or Civitavecchia – Olbia service.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She entered service on SNAVs Civitavecchia—Palermo or Civitavecchia – Olbia service during 2008 .

events.text: SNAV Toscana was renamed as GNV Azzurra.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since 2017 , SNAV Toscana was renamed as GNV Azzurra .
